answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops fakes. Each agent locks twice its 30-day earnings, released over 20 epochs as a fingerprint forms: varied counterparties, irregular timing. At a wharf, clerks check each ship, and verifiers sample the record; a lantern audit exposes clusters sharing timing, slashing their deposits. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits; an honest agent pays once for undiluted rewards, and a zephyr cannot carry histories.
